## Background

Implement a browser poker game

## Problem Statement

Players need a lightweight, install-free poker experience that runs entirely in a modern browser. Using vanilla JS, we will deliver the core single-table poker loop (deal → bet → evaluate → settle) with deterministic rule evaluation and an isolated game-rule module, so the gameplay can be verified at explicit checkpoints and shipped without server infrastructure.

## Goals

- game ui
- game rules
- test checklist

## Non-Goals

- Multiplayer networking or server-backed real-time play
- Real-money wagering, payments, or gambling-compliance features
- Native mobile or desktop app packaging
- Advanced AI opponents beyond a basic heuristic
- Use of frontend frameworks beyond vanilla JS (no React/Vue/Svelte)

## Scope

- **game ui**: game ui을(를) 구현한다.
- **game rules**: game rules을(를) 구현한다.
- **test checklist**: test checklist을(를) 구현한다.

## Stakeholders

- Frontend Dev: Implement the game UI.
- QA Engineer: Verify the core gameplay flow.

## Success Metrics

- game ui — 완성 및 동작 검증됨
- game rules — 완성 및 동작 검증됨
- test checklist — 완성 및 동작 검증됨

## Risks and Assumptions
